mapper.select: WITH RankedDeals AS ( SELECT deal.no, deal.apt_seq, info.apt_nm, info.umd_nm, deal.floor, info.sgg_cd, info.umd_cd, info.jibun, info.road_nm_sgg_cd, info.road_nm, info.road_nm_bonbun, info.road_nm_bubun, deal.deal_year, deal.deal_month, deal.deal_day, deal.exclu_use_ar, ROUND(REPLACE(deal.deal_amount, ',', '') / 10000, 2) as deal_amount, ROUND((deal.exclu_use_ar * 0.3025), 1) as footage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY deal.apt_seq ORDER BY deal.deal_year DESC, deal.deal_month DESC, deal.deal_day DESC ) AS rn FROM houseinfos info JOIN housedeals deal ON info.apt_seq = deal.apt_seq WHERE info.latitude BETWEEN #{swLat} AND #{neLat} AND info.longitude BETWEEN #{swLng} AND #{neLng} ) SELECT * FROM RankedDeals WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY deal_amount ASC

SELECT deal.no, deal.apt_seq, info.apt_nm, info.umd_nm, deal.floor, info.sgg_cd, info.umd_cd, info.jibun, info.road_nm_sgg_cd, info.road_nm, info.road_nm_bonbun, info.road_nm_bubun, deal.deal_year, deal.deal_month, deal.deal_day, deal.exclu_use_ar, ROUND(REPLACE(deal.deal_amount, ',', '') / 10000, 2) as deal_amount, ROUND((deal.exclu_use_ar * 0.3025), 1) as footage FROM houseinfos info JOIN housedeals deal ON info.apt_seq = deal.apt_seq WHERE info.apt_seq = TRIM(#{aptSeq}) ORDER BY deal.deal_year DESC, deal.deal_month DESC, deal.deal_day DESC
